description: The title menu. entries: in drawing order; kind = load | continue | new_game | options | exit (load and continue show when saves exist, continue also with an autosave, the others always); label = menu text key; offset_x = hand-measured half width of the untranslated label (absent = measured); sound = played when picked (sounds/sounds.json name); next = the game state the menu hands off to; next_alt = for continue the state when an autosave exists, for new_game the state when the opening movie is skipped. layout.touch_row_pitch: the row pitch on a touch screen (taller rows to tap; the difficulty list then ends no lower than last_row_y). idle_frames / intro_every / idle_state: what happens when the title is left idle. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
